q-0348.answer:
Surah Ar-Ra'd (13) — The Thunder · 43 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• He guides to Him those who repent, turn to Him, beg Him, seek His help and humbly submit to Him.
• Say, 'Allah is sufficient for me and He is the witness over me and you.
• Alif, Lam, Meem, Ra. These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.
• It is Allah who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then He established Himself above the Throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain.
• And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0414.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

q-0689.answer:
Surah Al-Bayyina (98) — The Evidence · 8 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Differing only occurred after the Knowledge came
• This is the reward that will be attained by those who revere Allah and fear Him as He deserves to be feared.
• The Command of Allah was merely that They make their Religion solely for Him
• They are the worst creation that Allah has fashioned and created.
• Muhammad ﷺ and the Magnificent Qur'an he recites, which is written down among the most high gathering in purified pages.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.
